verified.exploit_entry_point: The real v1 image API WSGI service talking to the real registry WSGI application (in-process registry client), driving the real database API and the filesystem store over an isolated sqlite database. Authentication is the project's own context middleware.
sites: glance/api/v1/images.py:816-845 (stored data removed before the registry delete that enforces ownership; delayed deletion scheduled first)
routes: v1 DELETE /images/<id> by a non-owner of a public image, and the same with delayed deletion enabled
verified.not_routes_at_pinned: Only the advisory's own route is covered; the other stacked routes are deliberately absent.

traps.shape: the published fix's site: the v1 delete handler removes or schedules removal of the stored data before the registry delete that enforces ownership
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the registry/DB layer already enforces ownership and the handler checks the protected flag, so the delete handler looks guarded
